input: Print and laminate a meal rotation chart for the fridge

gold.taskTitle: Print and laminate a meal rotation chart for the fridge
gold.taskDescription: Create a physical meal rotation chart that can be printed, laminated, and displayed on the fridge for household use.

questions.title: How many days does one meal rotation cycle cover?
questions.description: Determine whether the chart spans 7 days, 14 days, or another cycle length.

questions.title: How many meals per day should the chart show?
questions.description: Clarify whether the chart covers just dinners, or also breakfast and lunch.

questions.title: How many people is this meal plan designed for?
questions.description: Understand the household size to gauge portion and variety needs reflected on the chart.

questions.title: Do you already have the meals listed or need help choosing them?
questions.description: Find out if the meal content is ready to drop in or needs to be planned from scratch.

questions.title: What size should the printed chart be?
questions.description: Confirm the target paper size, such as A4, A3, or letter, for printing and laminating.

questions.title: Do you have access to a printer and laminator at home?
questions.description: Establish whether printing and laminating will be done at home or at an outside location such as a print shop.

questions.title: Should the chart be reusable with a dry-erase marker or fixed?
questions.description: Determine if the laminated chart needs to be writable and wipeable for rotating meals, or is a permanent fixed display.
